com.sun.tools.classfile

类 Dependencies

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.tools.classfile.Dependencies

  • public class Dependencies
extends Object
    A framework for determining dependencies between class files. A finder is used to identify the dependencies of individual classes. Some finders may return subtypes of Dependency to further characterize the type of dependency, such as a dependency on a method within a class. A filter may be used to restrict the set of dependencies found by a finder. Dependencies that are found may be passed to a recorder so that the dependencies can be stored in a custom data structure.

      • getAPIFinder

        public static Dependency.Finder getAPIFinder(int access)
        Get a finder used to locate the API dependencies for a class. These include the superclass, superinterfaces, and classes referenced in the declarations of fields and methods. The fields and methods that are checked can be limited according to a specified access. The access parameter must be one of ACC_PUBLIC, ACC_PRIVATE, ACC_PROTECTED, or 0 for package private access. Members with greater than or equal accessibility to that specified will be searched for dependencies.
        参数:
        access - the access of members to be checked
        返回:
        an API finder

      • getPackageFilter

        public static Dependency.Filter getPackageFilter(Set<String> packageNames,
                                                 boolean matchSubpackages)
        Get a filter which checks the package of a target's class name to determine if a dependency is of interest. The filter checks if the package of the target's class matches any of a set of given package names. The match may optionally match subpackages of the given names as well.
        参数:
        packageNames - the package names used to match the target's class name
        matchSubpackages - whether or not to match subpackages as well
        返回:
        a filter for checking the target package name against a list of package names

      • findAllDependencies

        public Set<Dependency> findAllDependencies(Dependencies.ClassFileReader classFinder,
                                           Set<String> rootClassNames,
                                           boolean transitiveClosure)
                                    throws Dependencies.ClassFileNotFoundException
        Find the dependencies of a class, using the current finder and filter. The search may optionally include the transitive closure of all the filtered dependencies, by also searching in the classes named in those dependencies.
        参数:
        classFinder - a finder to locate class files
        rootClassNames - the names of the root classes from which to begin searching
        transitiveClosure - whether or not to also search those classes named in any filtered dependencies that are found.
        返回:
        the set of dependencies that were found
        抛出:
        Dependencies.ClassFileNotFoundException - if a required class file cannot be found
        Dependencies.ClassFileError - if an error occurs while processing a class file, such as an error in the internal class file structure.

      • findAllDependencies

                                Set<String> rootClassNames,
                                boolean transitiveClosure,
                                Dependencies.Recorder recorder)
                         throws Dependencies.ClassFileNotFoundException
        Find the dependencies of a class, using the current finder and filter. The search may optionally include the transitive closure of all the filtered dependencies, by also searching in the classes named in those dependencies.
        参数:
        classFinder - a finder to locate class files
        rootClassNames - the names of the root classes from which to begin searching
        transitiveClosure - whether or not to also search those classes named in any filtered dependencies that are found.
        recorder - a recorder for handling the results
        抛出:
        Dependencies.ClassFileNotFoundException - if a required class file cannot be found
        Dependencies.ClassFileError - if an error occurs while processing a class file, such as an error in the internal class file structure.
